entries.name: On Attack / On Crit (+ Wielding: Polearm)
On Attack / On Crit (+ Wielding: Heavy)

system.description:
Toggle between being mounted on your wyvern or being unmounted.

While mounted in this way, this unit becomes a Flying and Dragon unit. Flying units cannot be attacked in melee, except by other Flying units. They may still be counterattacked in melee by any unit, if the Flying unit initiates the attack against them.

A hefty axe, made especially for military purposes.

Polearmbreaker
Armor made from the hide of wyverns.
A terror of the skies, Wyverners battle atop ferocious draconic companions. Though they are capable of wreaking devastation, they are vulnerable to arrowfire and some forms of anti-Dragon magic.

effects.name: Mounted: Wyvern
effects.description:
Mount Bonuses: +2 Mov, +5 HP, +1 Stn, +1 Eva, +3 Atk

Unit Types: Flying, Dragon
